# RAE Fleet Router

> RAE Fleet Router — Agent-to-Agent economy demo. Composes multiple x402 services into one paid bundle. Routes agent requests across the Royal Agentic x402 fleet.

## Endpoints

| Endpoint | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `GET /health` | Liveness check |
| `POST /route` | Route a request to the appropriate fleet service |
| `GET /.well-known/x402.json` | x402 Bazaar discovery manifest |
| `GET /catalog` | Tiered HTML catalog of all fleet x402 services — grouped by price (Penny Cluster / Value Band / Pro / Flagship) with capability tags |
| `GET /catalog.json` | Machine-readable service catalog (33+ endpoints with tier + tags) |
| `GET /penny-stack` | Cheapest 4 x402 walls — landing page with live prices |
| `GET /penny-stack.json` | Machine-readable penny-stack data |

## Protocol

Routes requests to x402 services on Base mainnet (eip155:8453).
Dependencies: `@coinbase/x402`, `@opensea/wallet-adapters`, `@x402/core`, `@x402/evm`, `@x402/express`, `@x402/extensions`

## Tests

```bash
node test_bundle_ladder.cjs && node test_prevalidation.cjs && node test_pay_failed.cjs && node test_sample_route.cjs && node test_badge_route.cjs && node test_resource_https.cjs && node test_benchmarks.cjs && node test_agent_card.cjs && node test_facilitator_advertising.cjs && node test_buy_routes.cjs && node test_payment_confirm.cjs && node test_catalog_json.cjs
```

## OpenSea Agent Discovery

This service integrates with the OpenSea/x402 ecosystem. AI agents can discover and interact with OpenSea via:

- **OpenSea llms.txt:** `GET https://opensea.io/llms.txt` — plain-text API overview for LLM context windows
- **OpenAPI Spec:** `GET https://api.opensea.io/api/v2/openapi.json` — full machine-readable endpoint descriptions
- **TOON Encoding:** Send `Accept: text/markdown` header to receive Token-Optimized Object Notation (~40% fewer tokens than JSON)
- **Instant API Key:** `POST https://api.opensea.io/api/v2/auth/keys` — free-tier key, no signup (600 read/h, 30 write/h, 7-day expiry)
- **OpenSea CLI:** `npx @opensea/cli`
- **OpenSea MCP:** `https://mcp.opensea.io/mcp`
